import os,re,json
def load():

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    fives=[(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r_) if v==5]
    # template = component of nonzeros containing >1 nonzero cell adjacent-ish; pick the 5 whose neighbors contain nonzero within distance<=2 besides other 5s
    import itertools
    def comps():
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for p in fives+[ (i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=5 and g[i][j]!=0]:
            if p in seen: continue
            st=[p]; comp=[]
            seen.add(p)
            while st:
                q=st.pop(); comp.append(q)
                for r2,c2 in [(q[0]+a,q[1]+b) for a in(-1,0,1) for b in(-1,0,1)]:
                    if 0<=r2<H and 0<=c2<W and g[r2][c2]!=0 and (r2,c2)!=p and (r2,c2) not in seen:

    return out
